purpose: Exercise the first bounded production slice of the vehicle-entry chain: approach, driver-side geography and pre-contact state.

canonical_scene.subject: one adult man with short dark hair, rectangular glasses, light facial hair and a dark charcoal shirt
canonical_scene.vehicle: one specific matte graphite compact hatchback, driver side facing the camera, continuous geometry and a small red marker on the driver-side mirror; no logo
canonical_scene.environment: wet residential curb at overcast late afternoon, stable cool daylight from camera-left
canonical_scene.screen_direction: subject enters from screen left and approaches the vehicle on screen right
canonical_scene.shot_start: subject several steps from the driver-side door; vehicle stationary and door closed
canonical_scene.shot_end: subject standing at the driver-side handle in pre-contact; vehicle stationary and door closed

reference_status.acceptance_consequence: Vehicle geometry/color and subject identity remain NOT_OBSERVED until actual frames are inspected against a source reference.
